channel.title: Roshan Kc — Founder & CTO Notes
channel.description: Essays from Roshan Kc on founding MarginTop Solutions, the CTO craft, building teams in Kathmandu, and shipping without losing trust.

item.title: PHP 8.6: New Features and the RFCs to Watch
item.description: PHP 8.6 ships November 19, 2026: partial function application, clamp(), Time\Duration, readonly defaults, Io\Poll and secure session defaults, with code examples.
item.author: kcroshan566@gmail.com (Roshan Kc)

item.title: PHP in 2026: Why Everything You Think You Know About PHP Is Out of Date
item.description: Is PHP dead? No. It runs ~70% of the web and ships yearly releases with enums, property hooks and a pipe operator. What changed since PHP 5, and what's missing.
item.author: kcroshan566@gmail.com (Roshan Kc)

item.title: How to Choose a Tech Stack in the AI Era: Follow the Patch Velocity, Not the Hype
item.description: Pick a tech stack for the team behind it, not hype or benchmarks. Why patch velocity matters now that AI finds bugs faster, plus a checklist for any stack.
item.author: kcroshan566@gmail.com (Roshan Kc)

item.title: Upgrading a Legacy PHP 7 App to PHP 8.5: A Practical Playbook
item.description: Step-by-step PHP 7 to 8.5 upgrade: end-of-life dates, tests, PHPStan, Rector, the breaking changes that bite, and how to roll out safely before PHP 8.2 support ends.
item.author: kcroshan566@gmail.com (Roshan Kc)

item.title: PHP Async in 2026: Fibers, Coroutines and the Road to Native Async
item.description: Can PHP do async? Fibers, ReactPHP, AMPHP and Swoole explained, plus PHP 8.6's Io\Poll, the engine concurrency RFC and PHP vs Node.js for real-time.
item.author: kcroshan566@gmail.com (Roshan Kc)

item.title: PHP Runtimes Explained: FPM vs Octane vs FrankenPHP vs Swoole vs RoadRunner
item.description: PHP-FPM, FrankenPHP, Swoole, RoadRunner and Laravel Octane compared: how each runs PHP, the trade-offs of long-running workers, and how to choose for production.
item.author: kcroshan566@gmail.com (Roshan Kc)

item.title: The PHP Type System Grew Up: From Loose Scripts to Strict Contracts
item.description: How PHP's type system evolved from PHP 5 to 8.6: strict_types, union and DNF types, enums, readonly classes, the missing generics, and how PHPStan fills the gap.
item.author: kcroshan566@gmail.com (Roshan Kc)

item.title: Property Hooks and Asymmetric Visibility: PHP 8.4 Changed How You Write Classes
item.description: PHP 8.4 property hooks and asymmetric visibility explained: replace getters and setters, virtual properties, private(set), and when not to use hooks.
item.author: kcroshan566@gmail.com (Roshan Kc)

item.title: PHP 8.5 Features That Actually Matter in Production Code
item.description: PHP 8.5 in production: the pipe operator, clone() with overrides, the URI extension, #[\NoDiscard], fatal error backtraces and array_first(), with before/after code.
item.author: kcroshan566@gmail.com (Roshan Kc)

item.title: Runtime-Level PHP Vulnerabilities: Why PHP2Shell Wasn't the First, and What They Have in Common
item.description: From CVE-2019-11043 and the 2021 php-src backdoor to CVE-2024-4577 and PHP2Shell: how PHP runtime bugs worked, what they share, and how to harden your servers.
item.author: kcroshan566@gmail.com (Roshan Kc)

item.title: PHP2Shell: How the PHP Team Contained a Critical RCE, and How the Fix Reached Your Server
item.description: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) explained: what broke, how PHP shipped fixes in hours, how patches reach production, and how we patched on Dashain Tika.
item.author: kcroshan566@gmail.com (Roshan Kc)

item.title: I Built a Public Docker Image for Laravel + Swoole with io_uring Support (Here's Why It Exists)
item.description: Free Docker image for Laravel Octane: PHP 8.5.12 + Swoole 6.2.3 built with io_uring, multi-arch (amd64 + arm64), Nginx and Supervisor. Patched for PHP2Shell.
item.author: kcroshan566@gmail.com (Roshan Kc)

item.title: Security Basics Every Early-Stage Startup Should Get Right Before Fundraising
item.description: Security basics early-stage startups should fix before fundraising: auth, secrets, encryption, access, dependencies, backups, logging — and SOC 2 sequencing.
item.author: kcroshan566@gmail.com (Roshan Kc)

item.description: Laravel Octane + Swoole vs PHP-FPM in production: 3–10× throughput, Octane::concurrently, memory leaks, state resets and graceful reloads, no rewrite needed.

item.title: What TypePHP Means for the Future of PHP Performance
item.description: What is TypePHP? Swoole's AOT compiler turns typed PHP into C++ and native code. How it compares to JIT and HHVM, Laravel support, and whether to bet on it.

item.title: Business Logic First: Why We Don't Worry About the Perfect Tech Stack
item.description: Why MarginTop prioritizes business logic over the perfect tech stack — AI lowers stack regret, while data and rules remain the real risk.

item.title: How to Run Your Startup Tech Stack for Free Until You're Funded
item.description: How early-stage startups stack AWS Activate, Azure, and Google Cloud credits to run infrastructure near $0 until funding or validation.
